meta.title: Next round watch
meta.method: Each CHFA round is scored on its own credit type (Round One 9%, Round Two 4% plus state, as every round from 2023 to 2026 was). Points for public evidence a project still needs credits: not funded a year earlier in the same round type 50, in an older round of that type 10, recent DOLA or Prop 123 rental money with a size that suits the round 25 (10 if it suits the other round or its size is not printed yet), not funded in the other round type 10, a sponsor that applied in 2 of the last 4 rounds 5, a Prop 123 land banking award 5. High 50+, Medium 25-49, Watch 10-24. A project leaves the list once CHFA awards it credit or while its application is undecided, in a round or on CHFA's rolling 4% list. Homeownership (AHOP) awards, projects under 15 homes and mobile home parks do not count as state-money signals: none has applied for credits.
limits: Public records only: a deal with no earlier application or state award is invisible until it applies.
CHFA prints neither "not awarded" nor "withdrawn"; outcomes are derived, so a dropped deal can look like a returner.
CHFA and Prop 123 awards carry a year, not a date, so the backtest counts them only once their year is over.
The rates were set on the same rounds they are tested on; the next applicant report is the real test.
meta.contacts_note: Contacts are kept only on the private developer site, never in this file.
